parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Laxmi Bai, widow of Pancham Singh, and others

facts_of_case: The appellants filed a civil suit for declaration that defendants have no right on Khasra Nos. 3, 38, 62, 1 (total area 19.657 hectare) situated in Village Vyauhari, Tahsil Hata, District Damoh.

legal_principles.principle: A child born of void or voidable marriage is not entitled to claim inheritance in ancestral coparcenary property but is entitled only to claim share in self-acquired properties.
legal_principles.held: This court holds that a child born of void or voidable marriage is not entitled to claim inheritance in ancestral coparcenary property but is entitled only to claim share in self-acquired properties.
cited_cases: Bharatha Matha and another Vs. Vijaya Renganathan & others, reported in AIR 2010 SC 2685
Jineakeotin and others Vs. Kumar Seetaram Manjhi & others, reported in 2003(1)SCC 730

legal_principles.principle: Marriage between Jagat Singh and Phoolan Bahu was not proved, therefore, defendants cannot claim benefit U/s 16 of Hindu Marriage Act.
legal_principles.held: This court holds that the marriage between Jagat Singh and Phoolan Bahu was not proved, therefore, defendants cannot claim benefit under section 16 of Hindu Marriage Act.
cited_cases: Resham Lal Baswan Vs. Balwant Singh Jwala Singh Punjabi, reported in 1994 MPLJ 446

use_for_drafting: representing clients in joint family matters
